name: Elegant Casting

components.pose: She stands in a sharp, athletic stance, one arm thrust forward with fingers spread as bolts arc from her fingertips, the other hand held back at her hip gathering a crackling sphere, torso twisted and hips cocked, a bold, smirking gaze to the camera. A violent gust whips her hem, sleeves and hair. Casting with her bare hands only.
components.effects: Forked bolts of {{MAGIC}} lightning arc from her fingertips and crackle around a sphere of energy in her hand, static lifting her hair.

notes: Elegant casting: unique gown that fits her magic, hands-only complex casting stance with wind.
